name: Enriched artificial seawater (f/2-type nutrients, salinity 35) (PMC9805005)
description: Enriched artificial seawater (f/2-type nutrients, salinity 35) — medium reported in PMC9805005 (complex/undefined base — extracts not BiGG-mappable).

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC9805005 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Complex medium: chemically-defined portion mapped to BiGG; biological extracts listed in `unmapped`. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification_evidence: "The growth medium consisted of artificial seawater enriched with vitamins and inorganic nutrients sufficient to produce a salinity of 35 and a total alkalinity of 2.4 meq · kg−1." ... "Concentrations of phosphate and vitamins were identical to those specified for f/2 medium; silicate was omitted. Trace metals were added in an EDTA-buffered solution as specified by Sunda and Hardison (2007)." ...

components.target_xref_note: these cross-references describe the BiGG id that was chosen; they were not used to choose it and cannot contradict it
components.mapping_note: [CHEM-B12-02] b12 ("Vitamin B12") carries no formula and no InChIKey and is absent from the BiGGr reactome, so it is an unusable exchange. Harmonised onto adocbl so one analyte does not occupy two ids across the resource (184 components were on b12 while 8,145 were on cbl1 for the same nutrient).

components.name: CO2 (carbon dioxide / dissolved inorganic carbon)
components.target_xref_note: these cross-references describe the BiGG id that was chosen; they were not used to choose it and cannot contradict it
components.mapping_note: [CHEM-CO2-01] Carbon dioxide is CO2 (formula CO2, InChIKey CURLTUGMZLYLDI-UHFFFAOYSA-N). cobalt2 is the cobalt(II) cation (formula Co, InChIKey XLJKHNWPARRRJB-UHFFFAOYSA-N). The two collided because BiGG's display name for cobalt2 is "Co2+", which lower-cases to the same key as "CO2"; the element sets are disjoint (C,O vs Co). Restricted to components already on cobalt2 whose name carries a carbon-dioxide/carbonate token, so the 12,009 genuine Co2+ rows are untouched.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
